description: Base config without automerge: recommended defaults, pinned GitHub Actions digests, no lock file maintenance, semantic commits, monorepo grouping, composer range bumps and a 3/5/7-day release age for patch/minor/major.

packageRules.description: No release timestamps available: pinning is safer than leaving unpinned
No release timestamps available: registries and datasources that do not expose them
No release timestamps on GHCR: allow the zizmor image through

Do not update the composer php platform requirement: it is not a package, so Composer cannot update it in composer.lock (the lock update fails and the content-hash goes stale), and with rangeStrategy bump every PHP release would raise the minimum PHP version (e.g. >=5.6.40 to >=8.5.12). Change it by hand
Commit bumped composer.json constraints together with composer.lock: composer.json uses bump-after-update, so a lock-only update leaves a content-hash that does not match composer.json

Trial set of PR table columns, for every update (Current value, New value and Package file already removed). Overrides the narrower set from config:recommended (mergeConfidence:age-confidence-badges). Delete the lines you do not need.
